title: Food Addiction & Binge Eating
description:
These daily affirmations are designed to support individuals recovering from food addiction and binge
eating. Recovery is a journey of healing your relationship with food, developing self-compassion, honoring
your body's needs, and finding healthy ways to cope with emotions. These affirmations encourage
mindfulness, emotional resilience, self-acceptance, and balanced living. They are intended to complement
professional treatment, nutritional guidance, counseling, and support from trusted healthcare providers
and recovery communities.

safety.disclaimer: This programme complements counselling, hypnotherapy, EFT, and trusted accountability. It is not a medical cure.
safety.reminder:
Recovery from food addiction and binge eating is about healing your relationship with food-not
striving for perfection. Lasting recovery involves learning to nourish your body, understand
emotional triggers, and practice self-compassion. Working with qualified healthcare professionals,
registered dietitians, therapists, or support groups can provide valuable guidance and support. Every
mindful choice is a step toward a healthier relationship with food, your body, and yourself.

modules.title: Strength & Growth
focus: I trust my body's natural wisdom.

modules.title: Freedom & Purpose
focus: I embrace balance instead of extremes.
My health is about caring for myself, not punishing myself.
I create a life where food supports my well-being rather than controls it.

activities.title: Closing affirmation and forward plan
activities.affirmation:
I am not defined by food, my body size, or my past eating habits. I am defined by my courage to
heal, my commitment to self-care, and my growing ability to nourish myself with wisdom and
compassion. Every day I choose recovery, I strengthen my body, renew my mind, and deepen my
respect for myself. One meal, one choice, and one day at a time, I am creating a life of balance,
freedom, health, and lasting peace.

fields.label: What will you keep practising after this journey?
What support do you still want?
Share this closing plan with Gerald
